name: Quartz.NET 4.6 SQL Server schema migration scripts (vendored, modified)
why: src/Platform/Yojana.Platform/Scheduling/migrations-4.6/add_scheduler_version_sqlServer.sql, add_fired_trigger_interrupt_sqlServer.sql and add_trigger_misfire_threshold_sqlServer.sql are copies of the Quartz.NET 4.6.0 migrations, taken at the commit the Quartz 4.6.0 package was built from, with the table schema changed from [dbo] to [quartz]; the modification notice is in each file header (Apache-2.0 section 4(b)). The upstream repository has no NOTICE file at that commit.
